articles.title: XRP sentiment falls to 8-month low, and that has been a buy signal before
articles.snippet: Santiment's weighted sentiment gauge for XRP just hit its weakest reading since October 2025. The firm notes the token's strongest rebounds have tended to start when the crowd was this checked out.

articles.title: Polish president vetoes crypto bill for third time ahead of MiCA deadline
articles.snippet: Polish President Karol Nawrocki vetoed a bill to implement MiCA for the third time, just weeks before the end of the EU crypto framework's transitional period.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Citadel Cautions Against the AI Trade Ahead of SpaceX IPO
articles.snippet: Citadel says the AI boom may be running into a cost wall, and Tether just led a $1.4B round into humanoid robotics.

articles.title: Google's DiffusionGemma AI Hits 1,000 Tokens Per Second—And It's Free
articles.snippet: DiffusionGemma hits 1,000 tokens per second by ditching word-by-word generation entirely. It just doesn't run on most people's machines yet.
